caveats: Per-cell MHWs: runs >=5 hot days first, then joined when separated by 1-2 non-hot days (gap days included). Cells with any NaN in target period excluded (land/partly missing); their mask is 0. Region grid cells 63.32-64.50 N, 21.32-22.50 E (60x60 native 0.02 deg grid). Thresholds/climatology use 1992-2002 baseline with pools from 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05 windows. Region bounds reported as requested; the native grid cells inside are 63.32-64.50 N, 21.32-22.50 E.
